blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Navotas Rep. Toby Tiangco’s bid to open the plenary-level discussions on the Congress’ proposed budget for 2027, did not push through as his motion was declared out of order. During Monday’s session, Tiangco repeatedly raised the need to review Congress’ budget, particularly the House of Representatives, in the name of transparency and accountability. Discussions on Congress’ 2027 budget were supposed to be held on September 24, but since several agencies’ proposed allocations were deferred, the House chose to tackle it by September 17. The interpellation period on Congress’ budget ended the same day. “Sana po payagan na ma-reopen ‘yong budget ng House, […]...
